body.x: 'yurbuds', maker of the sport earphones that feature patented TwistLock technology, guaranteed never to fall out, is displaying its newest products at CES International 2012. The company is featuring its latest innovations at premier media events during the consumer tradeshow, Tuesday, January 10 through Friday, January 13, 2012.

yurbuds sport earphones is featuring three models in their Ironman Series at the 2012 CES media events; Inspire Pro, Endure Pro and the Blaze. Each model is designed to contour to the human ear so they are comfortable and provide consistent sound quality, even while in motion. Designed as true sport equipment, yurbuds are sweat proof, water resistant, and provide ambient noise protection, which allows outside sounds to be heard, such as passing cars. All yurbuds products offer multiple sizing options, and can be personally fit to the size of the consumer’s ear. A personalized fit is available for all products through the yurbuds website.

“CES International is a unique opportunity for global media and retailers to experience firsthand a sport earphone that is guaranteed to never fall out, and why these products provide more comfort than any competitor on the market,” said Seth Burgett, CEO and Ironman triathlete of St. Louis based yurbuds. “Our newest products, the Inspire Pro and the Endure Pro, feature full iPhone 4S integration, allowing control of our product almost entirely with their voice, for an unsurpassed sport earphone experience.”

The Inspire Pro and Endure Pro models feature a 3-Button control and Dry Mic that allows easy navigation of an iPod, iPad, or iPhone. While the Inspire Pro offers a state-of-the-art, in-ear design, the Endure Pro provides behind-the-ear support with flexible and comfortable earloops that ergonomically cradle the ear. yurbuds is also featuring its Blaze sport earphone, which provide top of the line sound quality with an edgy design in a behind-the-neck model. Extremely lightweight and ergonomically shaped, the Blaze also offers yurbuds signature TwistLock technology coupled with a personal fit. These products are truly developed by athletes for athletes.

Experiencing rapid growth from 1,000 stores nationwide at the beginning of 2011, the latest yurbuds products are now available in over 9,000 retail locations in the USA, including Apple stores, Best Buy, Target and Walmart. Due to high international demand, 2012 distribution agreements are in place in Europe, China, Singapore, Latin & Central America, and Australia.
